+---
+'@tanstack/query-core': minor
+'@tanstack/query-persist-client-core': patch
+---
+
+feat(query-core): add `createPersisterRestoreResult` so persisters can restore a full query snapshot (errors, counters, timestamps, invalidation, infinite page params) instead of a fresh successful fetch; fine-grained persister restoration (single and bulk `restoreQueries`) now preserves the full persisted query state and merges data and error freshness independently with existing queries

index 000000000..6b18a0e96
--- /dev/null
+++ b/packages/query-core/src/persisterRestore.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+import type { QueryState } from './query'
+import type { DefaultError } from './types'
+
+const persisterRestoreResultKey = Symbol.for(
+  '@tanstack/query-core/persisterRestoreResult',
+)
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+> {
+  readonly [persisterRestoreResultKey]: true
+  data: TData | undefined
+  state: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>>
+}
+
+/**
+ * Creates a value which can be returned from a `persister` to signal that a
+ * persisted query snapshot was restored instead of freshly fetched.
+ * The provided `state` will be adopted as the query state as-is
+ * (errors, counters, timestamps, invalidation markers),
+ * instead of treating the result as a successful fetch.
+ */
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(restored: {
+  data: TData | undefined
+  state: Partial<QueryState<TData, TError>>
+}): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return {
+    [persisterRestoreResultKey]: true,
+    data: restored.data,
+    state: restored.state,
+  }
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult(
+  value: unknown,
+): value is PersisterRestoreResult<any, any> {
+  return (
+    typeof value === 'object' &&
+    value !== null &&
+    (value as any)[persisterRestoreResultKey] === true
+  )
+}
